T4_theThreeDefects.1_authority: Tier-1 §5 permitted only PERCENT and ILS — a CARDS measurement written as a rule for every family. Measured fee-terms domain: ILS 748, PERCENT 248, USD 117, OTHER 17, null 39, EUR 6. 123 foreign-currency rows, 118 of them calculationSafe, were being crashed on rather than shipped. MINE, not the executor's: its docstring cites the rule and documents the build failure as intended behaviour.
T4_theThreeDefects.2_process: THE CENSUS RAN AND WAS BLIND. §2.8 was added in v1.2 precisely to prevent schema-from-assumption, and it reported clean here because it printed JSON TYPES: `unit` read as string:1136/null:39, a healthy-looking field whose domain had five values of which the schema named two. A census that checks the shape of a value but not its content passes while blind, which is worse than not running one because it certifies the gap.
T4_theThreeDefects.3_code: readDeclaredCostUnit mapped any unrecognised unit to `undefined`, collapsing 'the estate declared no unit' into 'the estate declared a unit I have never heard of'. This survives the contract fix and was repaired regardless. Note: the supervisor's own first fix used describe(), which prints 'string', reproducing the defect — the test caught it in under a minute, which is the argument for asserting on error MESSAGES.

findingsRecordedNotActedOn: term:max|op:max:FOREIGN_ATM_FEE:2 reads 22 PERCENT against the FX pair's 3 PERCENT. A 22% foreign-ATM commission is not a plausible Israeli rate; this looks like an ILS amount wearing a PERCENT unit. NOT CORRECTED — inferring a unit from a magnitude is forbidden in both directions (§6.2). Needs a human read against the tariff.

executorCapabilityUpdate.finding: cursor-agent NEEDS A TTY. The same packet, model and flags: run foreground it edited files within 10 minutes; run detached it idled ~25 minutes with CPU moving 0.02 total, wrote zero bytes, edited nothing, and exited 1 — while the wrapper reported exit 0.
executorCapabilityUpdate.significance: This is the concrete case behind 'exit codes are ADVISORY ONLY' (OD-15). A false success with an empty log is indistinguishable from a slow success unless the worktree and CPU are inspected.
rules: The 10-minute foreground ceiling is real; split a packet into stages that each fit rather than backgrounding it.
Never infer progress from an empty log — --output-format json buffers until completion. Sample CPU twice.
When the tool cannot deliver inside the window, the supervisor implements it rather than spending the session on round-trips.

transferableLessons: Census the VALUE DOMAIN of an enumerated field, not just its JSON type. A type-only census reports a healthy field and certifies the gap.
Sample delegation fixtures BY COMBINATION. One example per field-level shape is not coverage when two fields interact — the missed cell here was value-present x unit-foreign.

An open question in a frozen schema is a defect with a due date. Costmodel v1.0 shipped 'whether any real row trips it is not yet measured'; the measurement was zero, but the adjacent unwritten case held 123 rows.
Assert on error MESSAGES, not just that something throws. The original defect WAS the message, and the supervisor's own first fix reproduced it.
A claim measured on a fixture is not a claim about the estate, and must not be written as one.
